slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the amount of product purchased in a given month available for sale in that same month, or does it only become available for sale in the following month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about same-month availability, covering part of the timing rule, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month (versus continuous or end-of-month), leaving the 'once at the beginning' constraint unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of the month and are fully available for sale throughout the month (implied by the inventory balance equation I_t = I_{t-1} + P_t - S_t).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only confirmed same-month availability, not the beginning-of-month timing or that there is a single purchase event at the start of the month.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while H1 (P1) was only partially resolved; the beginning-of-month purchase timing was never confirmed.

summary: The agent asked several clarifying questions and resolved many details, but missed explicitly confirming the beginning-of-month purchase timing (H1), leading to a partial hit and a premature stop.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
